comparison.objective: Hold a robot-arm bracket while inserting a servo into its close-fit pocket in the correct orientation.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual counterholding, oriented close-clearance insertion, and push-to-seat force.
comparison.success_condition: Servo correctly oriented and fully seated, bracket set upright, parts released and still.
comparison.reason: This tests press-fit component assembly; it lacks tool/setscrew engagement, adjustable collar rotation, lock restoration, and iterative dynamic-response tuning.
